mapper.select: select distinct t.role_name from safety_sys_role t left join safety_sys_user_role t1 on t.id = t1.role_id left join safety_sys_user t2 on t2.id = t1.user_id where t2.emp_no=#{username} and t.delete_falg='0' and t1.del_flag=0 and t2.delete_falg = 0 and t1.status = 0
select distinct t1.role_code from safety_sys_user_role t1 left join safety_sys_user t2 on t2.id = t1.user_id where t2.emp_no=#{username} and t1.del_flag=0 and t2.delete_falg = 0 and t1.status = 0

select distinct t.code from safety_sys_perm t left join safety_sys_role_perm t1 on t.id = t1.perm_id left join safety_sys_role t2 on t2.id = t1.role_id left join safety_sys_user_role t3 on t3.role_id = t2.id left join safety_sys_user t4 on t4.id = t3.user_id where t4.emp_no=#{username} and t4.delete_falg = 0 and t3.del_flag=0 and t2.delete_falg='0' and t1.del_flag = 0 and t.delete_falg = '0' and t3.status = 0

select distinct t.code from safety_sys_perm t left join safety_sys_role_perm t1 on t.id = t1.perm_id left join safety_sys_role t2 on t2.id = t1.role_id where t2.role_code=#{roleCode} and t.delete_falg = '0' and t1.del_flag = 0 and t2.delete_falg='0'
select t.code from safety_sys_perm t where t.delete_falg = '0'
